fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Medical astrology as an early warning system", "body": "Chance Garton opens by arguing that most people stay in denial about their health until the wheels fall off, and that a health centered reading of the birth chart can tip the scales toward acting sooner. Dominique Cordivari defines medical astrology as an ancient applied branch based on melothesia, the association of body parts, diseases and remedies with the sun, moon and twelve signs. She treats it as both a science and an art, leaning on intuition alongside the traditional rulerships, because one size never fits all when it comes to health."}, {"title": "The zodiac mapped onto the body", "body": "Dominique walks the whole body sign by sign. Aries takes the head, Taurus the neck, Gemini the shoulders, arms and hands, Cancer the breast and womb, Leo the heart and back, Virgo the small intestine, Libra the kidneys, Scorpio the reproductive organs and lower bowels, Sagittarius the hips, thighs and autonomic nervous system, Capricorn the knees and skeleton, Aquarius the calves and circulation, Pisces the feet and lymph. Chance says his biofield tuning work keeps confirming these pairings, especially clients with authority struggles who turn up again and again with damaged knees."}, {"title": "Epigenetics borrowed for the birth chart", "body": "The term epiastrology comes from splicing epigenetics onto astrology. Dominique quotes the dictionary definition of epigenetics, heritable changes in gene function without changes to the DNA sequence, then offers her own version, the study of alterations in the way your astrological and cosmic patterns express without changes to those patterns. Her slogan, borrowed from a Red Mountain natural medicine teacher, is that the stars are your tendency and not your destiny. She leans on Neville Goddard and Joseph Murphy to argue that awareness of a hard placement is what makes changing its expression possible."}, {"title": "Feeding the sun and reading Saturn honestly", "body": "Dominique's practical method starts with asking what a client actually wants, then works three places in the chart. The sun is consciousness and life force, so she talks about feeding it, a Libra through partnership, a fire sign through movement and heat, a water sign through baths and immersion. The moon holds emotional patterns and burns hot under stress. Saturn is the one most people would rather skip, and she insists on it, since knowing what Saturn touches and aspects is the only way to see which limits can actually be lifted."}, {"title": "Cell salts, crystals and real case studies", "body": "Cell salts are the twelve inorganic mineral compounds left as ash if you burned a body, one tied to each sign, and Dominique treats deficiency in them as a readable health problem. She traces her own dysautonomia to a Sagittarius sun squared by Saturn plus a moon conjunct Uranus in Aquarius, and notes the Aquarian salt is sodium chloride. A Cancer mother with failing tooth enamel took calcium fluoride, ate the matching foods and rested, and her teeth began regenerating. She points listeners to The Zodiac and the Salts of Salvation and the sixth, eighth and twelfth houses."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The stars are your tendency, not your destiny. Dominique Cordivari of EpiAstrology joins InnerVerse to discuss how to use astrology to improve wellness. Similar to epigenetics, medical astrology can be utilized to enhance our strengths and compensate for our challenges. Tune in to learn how Dominque provides coaching to help maximize our cosmic potential as fractals of Source, with customized crystals, homeopathic cell salts, and other holistic interventions. Break away with fatalistic astro-forecasts and harness your horoscope for your highest good!

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Crystals as Materialized Frequency", "body": "Dominique opens the second hour by describing crystals as materialized frequencies, beings in their own right that can support us on our journey, and Chance extends the idea animistically, suggesting energy and consciousness are one thing that takes the shape of its container, much like water. From there Dominique shows how a stone can literally embody a cell salt: rock salt, or halite, is crystallized sodium chloride for Aquarians, quartz carries the silica of Sagittarius, and peach selenite and angelite share the calcium sulfate tied to Scorpio, so reading a chart can point straight to a mineral you can hold."}, {"title": "Chart Patterns Meet Crystal Systems", "body": "Working through Chance's own chart, Dominique pairs each aspect pattern with a crystal lattice. His yod, the quincunx shape some call the fingerprint of God, calls for monoclinic stones like selenite, scolecite and charoite, which fit an easily swayed but quickly inspired personality. His grand cross wants cubic crystals to offset its squares and hexagonal ones such as apatite and aquamarine for its oppositions, while his two cradles bring in trigonal quartz, hexagonal beryls and triclinic amazonite and labradorite. She frames the whole method as astro homeopathy, like curing like, and says the internal structure matters more than the shape a stone is cut into."}, {"title": "Amorphous Stones and Everyday Practice", "body": "When Chance raises moldavite, Dominique explains that amorphous stones strip away boundaries, the same world without Saturn he described earlier, and Chance reveals he was wearing moldavite during that very experience. She adds black tektite, obsidian as a vacuum for negative energy that needs frequent cleansing, and rainbow obsidian for reopening a sense of possibility. The practical side follows: rubbing a stone like a worry stone, making elixirs only with tumbled, water-safe stones such as quartz while keeping soft selenite out of water, the indirect bowl method, and rings placed on planetary fingers, while Chance champions elastic bracelets and wire wraps in copper, silver or gold."}, {"title": "Subtle Energy and the Architecture of Meaning", "body": "Chance insists crystals are subtle and never a guaranteed fix, describing them instead as a way to welcome a frequency into your field so its other forms can find you, tipping the scales just enough while the body does the work, and Dominique likens this to biofield tuning and cell salts. He calls correspondences the fingerprint of the soul and says we are in a flowing conversation with archetypes, where real magic cannot be pointed at but can be trusted. Dominique then floats the idea that the masculine is crystallized and the feminine amorphous, and Chance relates it to routine and discipline versus responsive nurture."}, {"title": "Decoding a Personal Crystal Bundle", "body": "Dominique walks through the bundle she chose for Chance: scolecite for his yod, his prominent Libra moon, and its Chaldean value of 34, which matches her own first name through a numerology method she learned from her friend Seth using gematrinator.com; carnelian as a trigonal, Martian stone for his cradles and Leo rising; and cubic garnet for his grand cross. Chance shares how he pairs these stones with his tuning forks and places specific crystals such as kyanite, zebra stone and howlite on the tuning table, then questions the popular chakra assignments for Solfeggio tones while still using 528 hertz for the solar plexus."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I kind of see crystals as materialized frequencies. That would be the best way to describe it. They're beings in and of themselves, in my opinion.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think that there's a consciousness to energy, and actually, that energy and consciousness are the same thing, and that the consciousness takes on the shape of its container.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "So crystals are like astro homeopathy in the sense that you're prescribing a like to cure like.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I would never claim to somebody that if you get the right crystal, you're going to fix your life or overcome some acute problem just because of the crystal.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "A grand cross just doesn't seem to go away. It always feels like it's there.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We aren't just at the mercy of archetypes. We're in a flowing conversation with the archetypes.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "For anyone that's into manifesting, and I know manifesting can affect all of us in a very positive way, apatite is one of the most powerful manifesting crystals to exist.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Part of how magic works when it's real is you can't point to it and say, \"This did that.\" You can't say that, but you can trust it, and you can go with it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "In the beginning of the talk, we mentioned a world without Saturn, how it would have no boundaries. That's exactly what working with an amorphous crystal will do to you.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Earth signs benefit a lot from grounding and interacting with other earthy people.", "author": "Dominique Cordivari", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7485593-e00b-4ecf-948d-db298c063860/DOMINIQUE-CORDIVARI.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
